description.value: A pharmacological fMRI study examining how extended-release naltrexone modulates BOLD responses to audiovisual heroin cues in abstinent heroin-dependent patients.

value: we hypothesized that XRNTX would be associated with reduced limbic (amygdala and ventral striatum) and increased prefrontal (medial, orbital and inferior prefrontal gyri) BOLD fMRI signal along with diminished subjective craving response to audiovisual heroin cues.
